vehicles.name: Booster 22
vehicles.avid_graphic_note: AVID graphic: cryo 2×, SF 0× (stale — one 33-engine SF confirmed 25 Oct).
vehicles.latest_note: Flew Flight 15 (13 Nov 2026). Ascent and hot-staging succeeded. Boostback ended early due to low fuel mass (root cause not yet published). Guidance aborted the tower catch and diverted the booster offshore. Landing burn, hover, and FTS at landing-burn shutdown. No public FAA mishap statement found as of 25 Nov 2026.
